mapper.select:
SELECT c.CODE, c.TITLE, c.CONTENT, c.START_DATE, c.END_DATE, c.PROGRESS_STATUS, c.POST_STATUS, c.CREATED_AT,
a.EMP_ID AS ADMIN_ID, a.ROLE AS ADMIN_ROLE,
( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ce.MEM_CODE) FROM CHALLENGE_ENTRY ce WHERE ce.CHAL_CODE = c.CODE AND ce.STATUS IN ('JOINED', 'COMPLETED') AND ce.CANCELED_AT IS NULL ) AS PARTICIPANT_COUNT,
( SELECT i.PATH FROM IMAGES i WHERE i.TARGET_CODE = c.CODE AND i.TYPE = 'challenge' AND i.DELETE_YN = 0 ORDER BY i.ORDER_SEQ ASC, i.PATH ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS THUMBNAIL,
( SELECT COALESCE( ROUND( 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ce.STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN ce.MEM_CODE END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ce.MEM_CODE), 0), 1 ), 0 ) FROM CHALLENGE_ENTRY ce WHERE ce.CHAL_CODE = c.CODE AND ce.STATUS IN ('JOINED', 'COMPLETED') AND ce.CANCELED_AT IS NULL ) AS ACHIEVEMENT_RATE
FROM CHALLENGE c
LEFT JOIN ADMIN_ACCOUNT a ON a.CODE = c.ADM_CODE
ORDER BY PARTICIPANT_COUNT DESC, c.CREATED_AT DESC, c.CODE DESC
ORDER BY PARTICIPANT_COUNT ASC, c.CREATED_AT DESC, c.CODE DESC
ORDER BY ACHIEVEMENT_RATE DESC, c.CREATED_AT DESC, c.CODE DESC
ORDER BY ACHIEVEMENT_RATE ASC, c.CREATED_AT DESC, c.CODE DESC
ORDER BY c.CREATED_AT DESC, c.CODE DESC
LIMIT #{perPage} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHALLENGE ( ADM_CODE, TITLE, CONTENT, START_DATE, END_DATE, GOAL, POINT_EARNED, MAX_PARTICIPANTS, POST_STATUS, PROGRESS_STATUS, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, DELETE_YN ) VALUES ( #{adminCode}, #{title}, #{content}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{goal}, #{pointEarned}, #{maxParticipants}, #{postStatus}, #{progressStatus}, #{adminId}, #{createdAt}, 0 )
mapper.select:
SELECT CODE, GOAL, POINT_EARNED, MAX_PARTICIPANTS, START_DATE, END_DATE, PROGRESS_STATUS
FROM CHALLENGE
WHERE CODE = #{code} AND DELETE_YN = 0
FOR UPDATE
mapper.update:
UPDATE CHALLENGE
TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, POST_STATUS = #{postStatus}, UPDATED_BY = #{adminId}, UPDATED_AT = #{updatedAt},
GOAL = #{goal}, POINT_EARNED = #{pointEarned}, START_DATE = #{startDate}, END_DATE = #{endDate}, MAX_PARTICIPANTS = #{maxParticipants},
WHERE CODE = #{code} AND DELETE_YN = 0
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN DELETE_YN = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM CHALLENGE WHERE CODE = #{code} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update:
UPDATE CHALLENGE SET DELETE_YN = 0, UPDATED_BY = #{adminId}, UPDATED_AT = #{updatedAt},
PROGRESS_STATUS = CASE WHEN PROGRESS_STATUS = 'ENDED' THEN 'ENDED' WHEN END_DATE <= #{updatedAt} THEN 'ENDED' WHEN START_DATE > #{updatedAt} THEN 'WAITING' ELSE 'IN_PROGRESS' END
WHERE CODE = #{code} AND DELETE_YN = 1
